blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Pharmaceuticals & Biotech. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Pharma's frontier is acceleration under validation: discovery simulation, trial design, recruitment and pharmacovigilance all carry GxP duty. Companies that industrialize evidence pipelines compress the costly middle of the pipeline without compromising the audit.

items: Adverse-event intake spans channels and languages; case assembly is manual and backlogs breach reporting clocks.
Target and molecule screening compute-bound; HPC and emerging compute underused.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Hyperautomation & Systems Integration, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Discovery screening, Protocol eligibility matching, Pharmacovigilance intake) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GxP/GCP validation among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Workflows that recover from failure on their own — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: payer denial letters parsed, evidence assembled, appeal packets drafted (overturn rate up 20-30%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
